title.en: The One With the Move to Morocco

description.es: Andrés les informa a los trabajadores del traslado de la fábrica a Marruecos. Ante la incertidumbre, Marta ofrece a Claudia encargarse de la tienda mientras la fábrica permanezca en Toledo.
description.en: Andrés informs the workers about the factory's relocation to Morocco. Faced with the uncertainty, Marta offers Claudia the chance to take charge of the store while the factory remains in Toledo.
